csv_project_name: Consultant for Hotel Feasibility Study - Ashland
csv_scope_of_work: The purpose of this request for proposal is to accelerate the recruitment of quality hotel investment in Ashland. The Town seeks a qualified consultant to conduct a hotel feasibility study on a selection of sites within the Town limits. Task 1 Demand Study: Sports & Institutional Tourism: The first task is to review Hanover County s recent hotel demand study and apply a new Town-specific lens to the data. Task 2 Peer Locality Audit: Identify three to five peer localities within the Commonwealth of Virginia that have successfully attracted new hotel investment in the last five years. Task 3 Site Assessments: Conduct physical and economic assessment of 6 candidate hotel development sites 3 of the sites should focus on the suitability for a modern mid to upper scale branded hotel, one of which is within the Hospitality Incentive District along England Street between Interstate 95 and Route 1.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Feasibility Studies, Site Evaluation/Selection, Planning/Master Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
